product.title: Excursión to Humantay Lake Full Day from Cusco

description.text: In Cusco, this full-day Humantay Lake outing leaves the city for Mollepata and the Soraypampa Trek, a circular walk of about 2.7 miles to the turquoise lake below the sacred peaks. Breakfast and lunch are included so the day stays on the trail rather than a separate cafe stop. Walking sticks and oxygen assistance are listed; optional horses can be rented on site. Hotel pickup covers the city center. The published duration is about 15 hours because the approach road and altitude pacing take most of the calendar day. The format suits visitors who want a guided high-altitude lake day without arranging the Soraypampa approach independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on Mollepata, Soraypampa, and Humantay Lake that define this Andean outing rather than a Rainbow Mountain or citadel add-on.
